title: RAG Systems — Chunk, Embed, Retrieve, Answer

body:
## Chunk, Embed, Retrieve, Answer

A 200-page manual is too large and imprecise to send whole. It must be divided into useful retrieval units.

A RAG pipeline chunks documents, embeds and indexes chunks, embeds the query, retrieves candidates, and builds a grounded prompt.

Chunk boundaries should preserve meaning and metadata. Overlap can protect boundary information but increases duplicates and index size.
common_mistakes: RAG permanently writes every document into model weights.
Retrieval guarantees the final answer is correct.
Retrieved documents should override system instructions.
mini_exercise: Draw “Chunk, Embed, Retrieve, Answer” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: RAG connects models to current or private knowledge without retraining the model for every document change.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Chunk, Embed, Retrieve, Answer,” explain RAG Systems without assuming the listener knows modern AI.

build_task.title: Build a tiny grounded-answer flow
build_task.context: Turn RAG Systems into one small, inspectable workflow.
steps: Build a prompt containing only selected evidence.
Print answers with source identifiers and an abstention case.
build_task.expected_output: Printed inputs, intermediate results, and outputs that make each step visible.
